Volume: 250x250x331 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.

final_assistant_text:
The segmentation is saved.

**Case L09 summary**
- Target: lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on T1-weighted thigh MRI.
- Approach: located a large, elongated fat-containing mass in the anterior/deep compartment of the thigh (long cranio-caudal extent), seeded it with two positive points on the axial slice where it is widest (slice 155), then refined the boundary.
- Corrections: applied a light morphological opening to remove thin polar tails; reviewed all five-slice panels in three planes and confirmed the past-the-mask slices contain no residual lesion.
- Automatic candidate proposals (586/488/377 mL) were judged to be normal subcutaneous fat expanding outward from the mask and were rejected; the small 3 mL inferior proposal was at the image border and also rejected.
- Final mask: single connected component, 398.6 mL, extents axial 31–265, coronal 84–168, sagittal 112–178.
- Confidence: medium — the mass and its fat/muscle interfaces are clear, but the tapering poles leave some boundary uncertainty.
